rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a combat weapon and also for a figurative means of causing harm or gaining control.

example.english: You can't take this weapon on a plane.
example.traditional: 呢件武器唔可以帶上飛機。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 mou5 hei3 m4 ho2 ji5 daai3 soeng6 fei1 gei1

rows.note: Use this formal term for military weapons, rather than the everyday all-purpose term 武器.

example.english: This military weapon will be displayed at the military parade.
example.traditional: 呢種兵器會喺閱兵儀式上展示。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 bing1 hei3 wui5 hai2 jyut6 bing1 ji4 sik1 soeng6 zin2 si6

rows.note: Use this for a figurative weapon understood as a method or means of harming, pressuring, or controlling someone.

example.english: They use this kind of weapon to force people to submit.
example.traditional: 佢用呢種手段逼人就範。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 ni1 zung2 sau2 dyun6 bik1 jan4 zau6 faan6
